title: PPI AG has 40+ years of banking depth but owns the product IP that would compete
content:
PPI AG brings 40+ years in banking and insurance and is described as the payments market leader, which is genuine depth in exactly the vertical the payments and claims hypotheses target. The problem is what that depth rests on: it owns its payments product IP.

Owning product IP is the recurring disqualifier across this set. A firm whose revenue depends on its own payments products has that product sitting in the application-layer slot an engagement would need, so the relationship is structurally competitive even where the technical fit looks strong.

Its stack was not otherwise researched. It sits at priority 4 needing an open-source screen, but the constraint here is the product ownership, which a posture screen would not address.
